text:
mia: Quick Q — where should I look for TTFT and tokens/sec metrics (and p50/p95/p99) for hosted inference? Investigating a throughput regression, want to rule out cold-start vs steady-state.

raj: Grafana -> Observability / Inference -> Latency & Throughput. Panels we use: "TTFT (time to first token)" and "Tokens/sec by model". If you want raw PromQL: 
```
# p95 TTFT by model (5m window)
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(inference_time_to_first_token_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, model))

# tokens/sec total by model (1m)
sum(rate(inference_tokens_produced_total[1m])) by (model)

# request p95 latency across models (includes full response)
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(inference_request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, model))
```
Filter by `model=~".*-redwood-v1.*"` or add `region="us-west-2"` to the query for regional slices.

sasha: Where are the logs for TTFT traces? I want to correlate slow TTFT with model load or OOMs.

raj: Logs are in Kibana under the index `inference-logs-*`. Search for `request_id:` from the Grafana panel (click the point -> show raw ID). Traces go to Jaeger at https://tracing.redwood.internal (dashboard link on top-right of Grafana panels). Typical workflow: Grafana -> click point -> copy `trace_id` -> open Jaeger -> look at spans to see first token timing.

dan: For alert tuning, we changed p95 alert from 300ms to 250ms last quarter. If you think we should change thresholds for a given model, open a ticket and we can do a canary rule per model. Example alert expr we use (Prometheus alerting):
```
alert: HighTTFT_P95
expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(inference_time_to_first_token_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, model)) > 0.25
for: 5m
labels: { severity: "page" }
```
Note: thresholds are in seconds.

mia: Helpful — thank you. The regression shows tokens/sec drop and p95 TTFT up ~40% for model=sea-bench-v2 in us-east-1. I'll grab a trace.

raj: If tokens/sec drops but CPU/GPU utilization is stable, check KV-cache hit rate and batching size distribution. Panels: `kv_cache_hits_ratio` and `effective_batch_size` (both in the same dashboard). PromQL for batch size histogram: `histogram_quantile(0.5, sum(rate(inference_batch_size_bucket[5m])) by (le, model))`.

sasha: FYI I opened a tiny PR to emit `inference_time_to_first_token_seconds` for V2 runtime (adds a histogram). Link: https://git.redwood/inference/PR/4678 (will auto-deploy to staging).

ops-bot: deploy 4678 to staging succeeded :white_check_mark: (duration 3m 12s)

mia: ping @raj @sasha — I'll collect a few traces and post them here before raising an alert change ticket. Also can we add a tokens/sec panel that normalizes by concurrent requests? That would help separate per-request throughput vs overall capacity.

raj: Good idea — we already have `tokens_per_request = sum(rate(inference_tokens_produced_total[1m])) by (model) / sum(rate(inference_requests_total[1m])) by (model)`. I can add that as a panel under the model breakdown. Ping me if you want it scoped to a route instead of model.

mia: Perfect. Thanks all — will report back with trace IDs and a short summary.
